title: shopcore: a new required keyword argument for the pricing functions, callers hidden behind aliases, a registry, partial and getattr (Python, cross-cutting change)
prompt: The shop now sells in USD, GBP and CHF, but `shopcore` still computes every price in euros (a USD cart shows the euro amount under a "USD" label). Fix this: make `currency` a required keyword-only parameter (no default value) of both pricing functions in `shopcore/pricing.py`, so that they return the price converted into that currency (use `shopcore.currency.convert`), and update every caller in the package so that each item is priced in the currency of the cart / order / request it belongs to. Results in euro must stay the same. The tests in `tests/` do not exercise every entry point of the package, so check the callers yourself. Run the tests before you finish.
